verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows basic no-code pricing: a reusable list of products and prices plus one-time line items on Dashboard-created invoices, which amounts to simple per-unit pricing (docs-1, docs-6, docs-11). Credit notes exist, but they adjust or refund finalized invoices rather than act as prepaid usage credits (docs-18), and the product is described as invoicing for one-time payments (probe-2). missing for 10: tiered pricing, volume pricing, graduated pricing, hybrid subscription-plus-usage models, usage metering, prepaid credits, commitments/minimums, overage billing, and any independent corroboration.
